PlayerSave.title: PlayerSave
PlayerSave.description: Cloud save state for a Digimon RPG player, strictly isolated from PII and owned by a single Firebase Auth UID.

ownerUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

username.description: Display login handle chosen by the player.

tamerSelection.description: Selected Tamer avatar and in-game Tamer name.

starterDigimon.description: Permanent starter Digimon bound to the account.

adventureProgress.description: Last saved map ID, world coordinates, facing direction, step counter, and discovered zones.

hudState.description: Tamer & Digimon levels, EXP, HP, DS, active evolution, Bits, DWcoin, inventory, equipped items, optional custom Tamer portrait photo data URL (tamerPhotoUrl), optional custom Rank cover banner data URL (tamerCoverUrl), active XP boost expiration timestamp (xpBoostUntilMs), VIP Auto Farm unlock flag (autoFarmVipUnlocked), VIP Auto Farm 30-day expiration timestamp (autoFarmVipUntilMs), and battle counters.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud save profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest cloud save sync.

PlayerPrivateAccount.title: PlayerPrivateAccount
PlayerPrivateAccount.description: Isolated PII document storing the player's email address and auth provider, strictly restricted to the account owner.

ownerUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

email.description: Private email address linked to Firebase Authentication.

authProvider.description: Primary authentication provider used by the player.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest private record update.

UsernameClaim.title: UsernameClaim
UsernameClaim.description: Non-PII uniqueness claim linking a normalized username key to its owning player UID.

ownerUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID owning this username.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the username was claimed.

AlphaFeedbackReport.title: AlphaFeedbackReport
AlphaFeedbackReport.description: Player-submitted Alpha test bug report, suggestion, or balance feedback stored in Firestore.

ownerUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the reporting player.

tamerName.description: Active Tamer name at the time of submission (optional).

screenContext.description: Screen or map where the player submitted feedback.

message.description: Detailed bug report or suggestion written by the player.

deviceInfo.description: Device form factor and viewport metadata.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the report was submitted.

GmAdminRecord.title: GmAdminRecord
GmAdminRecord.description: Console-managed Game Master (GM) authorization marker granting exclusive admin privileges to a verified UID.

grantedAt.description: Timestamp when GM access was granted via Firebase Console.

WorldPresence.title: WorldPresence
WorldPresence.description: Real-time shared-world avatar presence document (zero PII) enabling online players to see, walk beside, inspect, and chat with each other on the same map.

ownerUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the online player.

digimonFormId.description: Active Partner Digimon evolution form ID.

mapId.description: Current world map where the player is located.

channelId.description: Active map channel number (1..5) enabling DMO-style multi-channel instances per map.

worldX.description: Tamer X coordinate in world pixels (0..20000).

worldY.description: Tamer Y coordinate in world pixels (0..20000).

partnerX.description: Partner Digimon X coordinate in world pixels (0..20000).

partnerY.description: Partner Digimon Y coordinate in world pixels (0..20000).

partnerMoving.description: Whether the Partner Digimon is currently walking.

isGm.description: Server-verified GM badge flag (only true if caller satisfies isAdmin()).

chatText.description: Most recent live world/map chat message for speech bubble and chat feed.

chatSeq.description: Monotonically increasing counter for chat messages (0..1000000).

online.description: Whether the player is actively present in the world.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest live presence or chat update.

WorldBossState.title: WorldBossState
WorldBossState.description: Shared real-time multiplayer Raid World Boss state (zero PII) synchronized across all players on the map.

mapId.description: World map hosting this Raid Boss.

name.description: Display name of the Raid Boss.

alive.description: Whether the Raid Boss is currently spawned and fightable.

respawnAtMs.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp when the boss respawns after defeat (0 while alive).

lastAttackerName.description: Display name of the most recent Tamer to damage the boss.

lastHitAtMs.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of the most recent raid hit.

contributors.description: Map of participating UIDs to { tamerName, damage } (up to 32 raiders).

defeatedCount.description: Monotonically increasing defeat counter used to distribute shared raid rewards.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest raid update.

ServerRatesConfig.title: ServerRatesConfig
ServerRatesConfig.description: Global server EXP multiplier event state managed exclusively by verified GMs (100%, 150%, 200%, 250%).

expRatePct.description: Active server EXP percentage (100 = normal, up to 250 = 2.5x).

updatedBy.description: Display name of the GM who set the active EXP rate.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest rate update.

GuildRecord.title: GuildRecord
GuildRecord.description: DMO-style multiplayer Guild record with emblem, tag, notice, level/EXP, passive skills, bounded members list, and recent guild chat.

name.description: Unique display name of the Guild.

emblemPhotoUrl.description: Optional compressed square data URL (JPEG/PNG/WebP, 128x128) uploaded by Guild leadership as the custom guild emblem photo.

notice.description: Guild master announcement / message of the day.

masterUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the current Guild Master.

masterName.description: Tamer name of the current Guild Master.

skills.description: Passive guild skill levels ({ expBoost, attackBoost, bitsBoost }).

recruiting.description: Whether new Tamers can freely join this guild.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of current member UIDs (max 50).

members.description: Map of UID to guild member profile (name, role, level, contribution).

chatMessages.description: Bounded ring buffer of the latest 25 guild chat messages.

dailyHuntDate.description: Server day key (YYYY-MM-DD, America/Sao_Paulo) for the active daily guild mob hunt.

dailyKills.description: Total mobs defeated by all guild members on dailyHuntDate (resets at 23:59 -> 00:00).

prevDayDate.description: Previous server day key (YYYY-MM-DD) whose final kills determine today's active Guild Event XP bonus.

prevDayKills.description: Final locked mobs defeated by all guild members on prevDayDate.

totalKills.description: Cumulative all-time mobs defeated by all guild members (never resets).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the guild was founded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest guild update.

PlayerRankingEntry.title: PlayerRankingEntry
PlayerRankingEntry.description: Zero-PII public leaderboard snapshot for Tamer and Digimon rankings.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the ranked player.

digimonName.description: Active Digimon display name or nickname.

tamerPhotoUrl.description: Optional compressed square data URL (JPEG/PNG/WebP) uploaded as custom Tamer portrait photo (or null).

tamerCoverUrl.description: Optional compressed 3:1 cover banner data URL (JPEG/PNG/WebP) displayed behind player cards in Rankings (or null).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest ranking sync.

GuildRankingEntry.title: GuildRankingEntry
GuildRankingEntry.description: Zero-PII public leaderboard snapshot for Guild rankings across all server guilds.

emblemPhotoUrl.description: Optional compressed guild emblem photo data URL.

masterName.description: Tamer name of the Guild Master.

totalKills.description: All-time total mobs defeated by the guild.

dailyKills.description: Mobs defeated today by the guild.

recruiting.description: Whether the guild is currently open for recruitment.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest guild ranking sync.

DwCoinPurchaseOrder.title: DwCoinPurchaseOrder
DwCoinPurchaseOrder.description: Server-validated DWcoin recharge order recording mandatory pre-payment terms acceptance (v1.0) without any sensitive card PII.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the purchasing player.

packId.description: Official DWcoin package ID from the store catalog.

dwCoinAmount.description: Exact DWcoin amount bound to packId.

priceCents.description: Exact package price in BRL cents bound to packId.

priceBrlLabel.description: Display price string in BRL matching the catalog package.

termsAccepted.description: Must be true before checkout can initiate.

termsVersion.description: Version of the mandatory pre-payment terms accepted by the player.

termsAcceptedAt.description: Server timestamp when the player accepted the purchase terms.

termsAcceptedAtIso.description: Client ISO timestamp recorded alongside the server timestamp.

status.description: Order payment status (starts pending; clients can only cancel, never self-approve).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the order was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest order status update.

PartyRecord.title: PartyRecord
PartyRecord.description: Real-time multiplayer 4-player grinding Party (leader + up to 3 teammates, zero PII) supporting live member vitals, shared map EXP events, and Party chat.

leaderUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the current Party Leader.

leaderName.description: Display Tamer name of the current Party Leader.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of 1..4 Party member UIDs.

members.description: Map of member UID to zero-PII Party member snapshot (Tamer photo, Digimon form/name, level, HP/maxHp, mapId, channelId).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Party was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest Party update.

PartyInvite.title: PartyInvite
PartyInvite.description: Targeted Party invitation sent from a Party member to another verified online player (zero PII).

fromUid.description: UID of the inviting Party member.

fromName.description: Display Tamer name of the inviting player.

fromTamerLevel.description: Tamer level of the inviting player (1..200).

fromCharacterId.description: Tamer avatar ID of the inviting player.

fromPhotoUrl.description: Optional compressed portrait photo of the inviting player (or null).

fromDigimonFormId.description: Active Digimon form ID of the inviting player.

toName.description: Display Tamer name of the invited player.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the invite was sent.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest invite state update.

PartyXpEvent.title: PartyXpEvent
PartyXpEvent.description: Ephemeral mob-kill EXP sharing event emitted by a Party member to grant shared XP to teammates on the same map.

killerUid.description: UID of the Party member who defeated the wild Digimon.

killerName.description: Display name of the Party member who defeated the wild Digimon.

mapId.description: Map ID where the mob was defeated.

channelId.description: World Channel ID (1..5) where the mob was defeated for strict same-channel party XP sharing.

mobName.description: Name of the defeated wild Digimon.

mobLevel.description: Level of the defeated wild Digimon (1..200).

baseExp.description: Base EXP generated by the defeat (1..50000000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of the EXP event.

PartyChatMessage.title: PartyChatMessage
PartyChatMessage.description: Private Party-only chat message visible exclusively to members of the same Party.

senderUid.description: UID of the sending Party member.

senderName.description: Display Tamer name of the sender.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was sent.

DwCoinTransaction.title: DwCoinTransaction
DwCoinTransaction.description: Immutable ledger entry recording DWcoin shop spending, recharges, and GM currency adjustments across the server.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player account.

tamerName.description: Player Tamer display name at the time of transaction.

dwCoinAmount.description: Positive DWcoin quantity involved in the transaction.

itemKey.description: Shop offer ID or recharge pack ID.

balanceAfter.description: Player DWcoin balance immediately after this transaction.

BannedAccount.title: BannedAccount
BannedAccount.description: Server-enforced account suspension/ban record managed exclusively by verified GMs.

reason.description: Official GM reason displayed to the suspended account.

bannedByUid.description: Verified GM UID who issued the ban.

bannedByName.description: Display name of the GM who issued the ban.

permanent.description: Whether the ban is permanent or temporary.

expiresAtMs.description: Epoch millisecond expiration for temporary bans (0 when permanent).

active.description: Whether the ban is currently enforced.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the ban record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest ban/unban update.

ServerAnnouncement.title: ServerAnnouncement
ServerAnnouncement.description: Live server-wide GM broadcast banner and maintenance notice stored under serverConfig/announcement.

announcementId.description: Unique broadcast ID for client deduplication.

message.description: Announcement message body shown to all online players.

maintenanceMode.description: Flags whether scheduled maintenance is active.

active.description: Controls whether the broadcast banner is active.

updatedBy.description: Display name of the GM who published the notice.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the announcement was published.

GmAuditLog.title: GmAuditLog
GmAuditLog.description: Immutable audit trail of GM administrative actions across the server.

actorUid.description: Verified GM UID who executed the action.

targetUid.description: Optional target player UID affected by the action.

targetName.description: Optional target player or resource display label.

summary.description: Human-readable description of the GM action.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of the GM action.

GlobalChatMessage.title: GlobalChatMessage
GlobalChatMessage.description: Server-wide cross-map Global Chat message visible to all verified online players regardless of map.

senderUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the sender.

senderName.description: Display Tamer name of the sender.

mapId.description: Map where the sender was located when sending.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created.

GuildInvite.title: GuildInvite
GuildInvite.description: Targeted Guild invitation sent by a Guild Leader or Sub-Leader to another verified online player.

fromUid.description: UID of the inviting Guild Leader or Sub-Leader.

fromName.description: Display Tamer name of the inviter.

fromRole.description: Role of the inviter within the Guild.

toName.description: Display Tamer name of the invited player.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the invite was sent.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest invite state update.

PlayerMarketListing.title: PlayerMarketListing
PlayerMarketListing.description: Player-to-player DATS Center marketplace listing (zero PII) with a server-enforced 2-minute public pre-listing countdown before purchase unlocks.

sellerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the selling player.

sellerName.description: Public Tamer display name of the seller.

itemKey.description: Catalog item key (non-sellable keys such as digiegg_demimeramon are forbidden).

itemName.description: Display name of the listed item.

itemCategory.description: Inventory category of the listed item.

itemRarity.description: Rarity tier of the listed item.

itemIconUrl.description: Optional icon asset path for the listed item.

eggHatchLevel.description: DigiEgg reinforcement stage (0..5; 0 for non-egg items).

buyerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the buyer once sold (or null).

buyerName.description: Display Tamer name of the buyer once sold (or null).

payoutClaimed.description: Whether the seller has already claimed the Bits payout from a sold listing.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the listing was posted (purchase unlocks at createdAt + 120s).

soldAt.description: Server timestamp when the listing was purchased (or null).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest listing update.

ReferralCode.title: ReferralCode
ReferralCode.description: Immutable zero-PII unique invite code mapping (code -> ownerUid) generated once per verified player account.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player owning this invite code.

tamerName.description: Public Tamer display name of the invite code owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the invite code was provisioned.

ReferralProfile.title: ReferralProfile
ReferralProfile.description: Public zero-PII inviter summary and monthly/all-time leaderboard counters per player account.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the inviter.

inviteCode.description: Immutable unique invite code owned by this player.

tamerPhotoUrl.description: Optional compressed square Tamer portrait photo data URL (or null).

tamerCoverUrl.description: Optional compressed 3:1 Rank cover banner data URL (or null).

totalInvites.description: Cumulative all-time count of accounts that used this player's invite code or link.

monthKey.description: Active ranking month key (YYYY-MM, America/Sao_Paulo) for monthlyInvites and monthlyCommissionEarned.

monthlyInvites.description: Count of invited accounts registered during monthKey.

totalCommissionEarned.description: Cumulative 10% DL Din commission earned from referred players' recharges.

monthlyCommissionEarned.description: 10% DL Din commission earned during monthKey.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the referral profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest referral profile update.

ReferralClaim.title: ReferralClaim
ReferralClaim.description: Immutable one-time referral link binding a referred account (docId = referredUid) to its inviter (referrerUid) so every DL Din recharge awards 10% to the inviter.

referredUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the invited player.

referredName.description: Display Tamer name of the invited player.

referrerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the inviting player (strictly != referredUid).

referrerName.description: Display Tamer name of the inviting player.

inviteCode.description: Invite code redeemed by the invited player.

monthKey.description: Month key (YYYY-MM) when the invite code was redeemed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the invite code was claimed.

/players/{userId}.description: Per-user cloud save document for Tamer, Starter Digimon, world position, and HUD RPG progression.

/players/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated PII subcollection (docId = 'account') strictly readable and writable only by the owner.

/usernames/{usernameKey}.description: Unique non-PII username registry preventing duplicate player handles.

/alphaFeedback/{reportId}.description: Alpha test player bug reports and suggestions readable/deletable by their author or the verified GM account.

/admins/{userId}.description: Read-only GM role registry managed exclusively in Firebase Console; zero client writes allowed.

/worldPresence/{userId}.description: Live zero-PII multiplayer avatar presence and world chat broadcast per verified player.

/worldBosses/{bossId}.description: Shared real-time multiplayer Raid Boss state for cooperative bosses such as Kuwagamon in Floresta de Dados.

/serverConfig/{configId}.description: Server-wide EXP rate event configuration (docId = 'rates') readable by verified players and writable only by GMs.

/guilds/{guildId}.description: Multiplayer DMO-style Guild documents supporting creation, recruitment, role hierarchy, guild skills, EXP progression, and guild chat.

/playerRankings/{userId}.description: Zero-PII public leaderboard snapshots for server Tamer and Digimon rankings.

/guildRankings/{guildId}.description: Zero-PII public leaderboard snapshots for server Guild rankings.

/dwCoinOrders/{orderId}.description: Pending and audited DWcoin purchase orders storing pre-payment terms acceptance (v1.0) without sensitive card PII.

/parties/{partyId}.description: Real-time multiplayer 4-player grinding Parties (leader + up to 3 teammates) with live member vitals and roster state.

/parties/{partyId}/xpEvents/{eventId}.description: Append-only Party mob-kill XP sharing events scoped to active Party members.

/parties/{partyId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Append-only Party chat messages readable and writable only by active Party members.

/partyInvites/{inviteId}.description: Targeted Party invitations readable and resolvable only by the sender and recipient.

/dwCoinTransactions/{txId}.description: Immutable server DWcoin ledger tracking shop item spending, approved recharges, and GM currency grants.

/bannedAccounts/{userId}.description: GM-managed account suspension and ban records enforced on login and live play.

/gmAuditLogs/{logId}.description: Immutable administrative audit logs visible exclusively to verified GMs.

/globalChat/{messageId}.description: Server-wide cross-map Global Chat messages readable by all verified online players.

/guildInvites/{inviteId}.description: Targeted Guild invitations sent by Guild Leaders or Sub-Leaders and resolved by the invited player.

/playerMarketListings/{listingId}.description: Global player-to-player marketplace listings in DATS Center with a server-enforced 2-minute public pre-listing window before purchase unlocks.

/referralCodes/{code}.description: Unique zero-PII invite code registry mapping uppercase invite codes to their owning player UID.

/referralProfiles/{userId}.description: Public zero-PII inviter profiles powering the monthly and all-time Invites ranking and player referral dashboard.

/referralClaims/{referredUid}.description: Immutable one-time referral claims linking each invited account to its inviter for instant counting and 10% DL Din recharge commissions.
